subject: Kickoff: Clearline AI vendor activation & privacy intake

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Kickoff: Clearline AI vendor onboarding & procurement checklist

Hi Alex / Clearline team,

Welcome — excited to kick off vendor activation for Clearline AI. I'm Hannah on Redwood procurement; looping in Steph (vendor owner) and Marissa (security intake lead). To get you into our vendor portal and issue a PO we need a few items to complete the procurement checklist:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached).
- Subprocessor list and short description of roles for each processor.
- Proofs: SOC-type attestation or security questionnaire PDF.
- Confirmation of DPA needs and whether your org can sign our standard DPA (we can share a DocuSign link).
- Typical PO/payment terms you accept (net30, net45, prepaid, etc.) and tax information (W-9 or equivalent).
- Expected data retention defaults and whether any subprocessors have access to plaintext data.

Could you review and return the completed form plus the subprocessor file and any attestation by EOD tomorrow if possible? If you have a preferred DPA redline process let us know — otherwise we'll send our template via DocuSign.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_template.docx

Next steps after we receive the materials: create vendor record, run security intake, send DPA for signature, then issue PO.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Clearline AI vendor onboarding & procurement checklist

Hi Hannah / Steph / Marissa — thanks for the ping.

We filled out the onboarding items and attached a current subprocessor inventory and our security attestation. High level answers up front:

- Subprocessors: AWS (us-east-1), LogStream Inc. (log aggregation), and Transcrypt (tokenization). Details in attached Subprocessors_List_2026.xlsx.
- Security: we’ve attached our latest Security_SAAS_Attestation.pdf (ISO-aligned controls).
- DPA: we can sign a customer DPA. We usually review a few minor commercial redlines but can generally accept standard privacy language. If you send via DocuSign that’s easiest.
- PO terms: standard net30 works for us.
- Tax: company EIN and W-9 available on request — we can attach if you prefer in the secure portal.
- Retention: default 30 days for logs; product data retention depends on customer config — see spreadsheet for service-level notes.

Attachments: Subprocessors_List_2026.xlsx; Security_SAAS_Attestation.pdf

Let us know if you want any subprocessor contacts or to schedule a short tech call to walk through where data is stored and processed.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Head of Customer Success | Clearline AI
alex@clearline.ai

Thanks Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments.

Quick follow-ups for procurement & security intake:
- Can you confirm whether any of your subprocessors have the ability to access plaintext customer input (i.e., unencrypted text before tokenization)?
- For the retention note, when you say "default 30 days for logs" is that configurable per-customer and do you support shorter retention windows (7/14 days) on request?
- Please confirm whether Transcrypt performs tokenization in our dedicated region (us-east-1) or if they operate cross-region.

I attached our completed onboarding form (filled where we have defaults) so you can populate your vendor-side copy — filename: RI_onboarding_form_stephanie_filled.pdf.

Also: legal asked whether Clearline will accept Redwood's standard DPA via DocuSign with only minor commercial redlines. I'll send the DocuSign link once procurement creates the vendor record. If you have specific clauses you typically redline, please flag them now (data localization, subprocessors, or indemnity).

Thanks — hoping to keep this light-touch and get the DPA signed this week.

—Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Morgan <alex@clearline.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Clearline AI vendor onboarding & procurement checklist

On Tue, Dec 1, 2026 at 1:05 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Can you confirm whether any of your subprocessors have the ability to access plaintext customer input (i.e., unencrypted text before tokenization)?

Hi Steph — quick clarifications inline below and attaching our completed onboarding form for your records.

- Plaintext access: Transcrypt and LogStream do NOT have access to customer plaintext. Our ingestion pipeline performs tokenization and encryption in our ingestion layer before logs are forwarded. Only Clearline systems (in a zero-trust segment) can access raw input for necessary debugging (very limited, audited).
- Retention config: yes, retention windows are configurable per-customer. We support 7 / 14 / 30 / custom windows and can implement shorter retention on onboarding.
- Transcrypt region: they operate primarily in us-east-1 for our US customers; cross-region transfers only happen for disaster recovery and are subject to customer consent.
- DPA / redlines: we reviewed a few standard customer DPAs; typical redlines we request are around point-in-time data deletion warranty and liability caps. We can accept your DocuSign DPA and will route any redlines via our legal team within 48 hours.
- Tax: attached is a signed Onboarding_Form_Filled_By_Clearline.pdf with company info and an included EIN. Also attaching a sample PO_terms_sample.pdf that shows our commercial preferences.

Attachments: Onboarding_Form_Filled_By_Clearline.pdf; PO_terms_sample.pdf

Happy to jump on a 20–30 minute tech call tomorrow if that helps.

Regards,
Alex
